Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one full-frame cinematic horror game cutscene illustration, part of a coherent seven-image sequence.
Style/medium: polished dark surreal cinematic concept art, realistic anatomy and materials, restrained painterly texture, physically convincing volumetric light, expressive silhouettes, strong dramatic composition, atmospheric depth and fine film grain. Professional art direction. Landscape 16:9, high resolution, image fills entire canvas.
Shared visual treatment: deep charcoal shadows, smoky atmosphere, luminous amber/yellow fire and door light, cyan blue reserved for supernatural eyes. Chiaroscuro, clear focal hierarchy, retain readable shadow detail.
Character continuity when a man appears: the same adult man about 35, short dark slightly tousled hair, light stubble, charcoal work jacket over a faded gray shirt, dark trousers, worn boots; ordinary believable proportions. Shadow figure when present: tall featureless humanoid silhouette, edges dissolving subtly into black smoke, no visible face.
Constraints: depict exactly this single requested scene, not a collage or storyboard sheet. No text, numbers, captions, logos, watermark, frame or letterboxing. No extra characters. No graphic injuries or gore. Hands and limbs must be anatomically coherent.
Primary request: Against an intensely bright backlight, an amorphous creature with blue eyes thrusts a closed fist toward the camera.
Scene: a dark smoky void torn open by radiant white-gold light behind the creature. Its body is shapeless roiling shadow, without stable human anatomy, but two piercing blue eyes are clearly visible and one arm condenses into a single clenched fist extended directly at the viewer.
Composition: extreme low, close perspective; enormous foreshortened fist dominates the near foreground, the blue eyes remain visible above and behind it. The luminous background outlines the creature's fluid silhouette. Convey explosive forward motion with subtle motion in smoke, while eyes and fist stay visually clear. No contact, no victim.
